an8.50:1.1: Catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, ayaṃsa loko āraddho hoti.
an8.50:1.3: Idha bhikkhave mātugāmo susaṃvihitakammanto hoti, saṅgahitaparijjano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
an8.50:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mātugāmo susaṃvihitakammanto hoti? 3.
an8.50:2.2: Idha bhikkhave mātugāmo ye te bhattu abbhantarā kammantā . . . pe . . .
an8.50:2.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mātugāmo susaṃvihitakammanto hoti.
an8.50:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mātugāmo saṅgahitaparijjano hoti? 4.
an8.50:3.2: Idha bhikkhave mātugāmo yo so bhattu abbhantaro antojano . . . pe . . .
an8.50:3.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mātugāmo saṅgahitaparijjano hoti.
an8.50:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati? 5.
an8.50:4.2: Idha bhikkhave mātugāmo yaṃ bhattu amanāpasaṃkhātaṃ, taṃ jīvitahetu pi na ajjhācarati.
an8.50:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati.
an8.50:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mātugāmo sambhataṃ anurakkhati? 6.
an8.50:5.2: Idha bhikkhave mātugāmo yaṃ bhattā āharati . . . pe . . .
an8.50:5.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mātugāmo sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
an8.50:5.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, ayaṃ sa loko āraddho hoti. 7.
an8.50:6.1: Catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo paralokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, parassa loko āraddho hoti.
an8.50:6.3: Idha bhikkhave mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti, sīlasampanno hoti, cāgasampanno hoti, paññāsampanno hoti.
an8.50:7.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti? 9.
an8.50:7.2: Idha bhikkhave mātugāmo saddho hoti . . . pe . . .
an8.50:7.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti.
an8.50:8.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mātugāmo sīlasampanno hoti? 10.
an8.50:8.2: Idha bhikkhave mātugāmo pāṇātipātā pāṭivirato hoti . . . pe . . .
an8.50:8.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mātugāmo sīlasampanno hoti.
an8.50:9.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mātugāmo cāgasampanno hoti? 11.
an8.50:9.2: Idha bhikkhave mātugāmo vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati . . . pe . . .
an8.50:9.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mātugāmo cāgasampanno hoti.
an8.50:10.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mātugāmo paññāsampanno hoti? 12.
an8.50:10.2: Idha bhikkhave mātugāmo paññavā hoti . . . pe . . .
an8.50:10.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mātugāmo paññāsampanno hoti.
an8.50:10.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo paralokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, parassa loko āraddho hotī ti.
an8.50:15.4: Nakulā idhalokikā dve ti. Paṇṇāsakaṃ samattaṃ. 1.
